title: First part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0173 units. Begin by drawing the first face of the rectangular prism. This involves creating two closed loops. For the first loop, draw a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.3173), followed by a line from (0.75, 0.3173) to (0.0, 0.3173), and finally back to the origin. For the second loop, start at (0.0346, 0.0346) and draw a line to (0.7154, 0.0346), then from (0.7154, 0.0346) to (0.7154, 0.2827), followed by a line from (0.7154, 0.2827) to (0.0346, 0.2827), and finally back to (0.0346, 0.0346). After completing the loops, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire 2D sketch. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it with the same Euler angles used initially and translating it with the same vector. Finally, extrude the 2D sketch 0.0087 units in both the positive and negative directions along the normal to create a solid body. The resulting dimensions of the first part will be a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.3173 units, and a height of 0.0173 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer rectangle
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0).lineTo(0.75, 0.3173).lineTo(0.0, 0.3173).close()

# Define the inner rectangle
r = r.moveTo(0.0346, 0.0346).lineTo(0.7154, 0.0346).lineTo(0.7154, 0.2827).lineTo(0.0346, 0.2827).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.0087, both=True)

# Translate the object
r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0173))

# Final model
r  # This will be the final model

# Display the model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch for the rectangular frame
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.3173).lineTo(0, 0.3173).close()

# Define the inner loop for the frame
inner_loop = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0348, 0.0348).lineTo(0.7152, 0.0348).lineTo(0.7152, 0.2825).lineTo(0.0348, 0.2825).close()

# Perform the extrusion
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0174)

# Perform the cut operation to create the frame
frame = extrusion.cut(inner_loop.extrude(0.0174))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = frame

import cadquery as cq

# Define the outer dimensions
outer_length = 0.7500
outer_width = 0.3173
thickness = 0.0174

# Define the inner cutout dimensions (wall thickness of 0.0174 on all sides)
inner_length = outer_length - 2 * 0.0174
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * 0.0174

# Create the outer rectangle and cut the inner rectangle to form the frame

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(outer_length, outer_width)
    .rect(inner_length, inner_width)
    .extrude(thickness)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the dimensions
width = 0.75
height = 0.3173
thickness = 0.0174
outer_radius = 0.007
inner_radius = 0.0025

# Define the sketch for the top face
r = r.moveTo(0, outer_radius) \
     .threePointArc((outer_radius, 0), (2 * outer_radius, outer_radius)) \
     .lineTo(width - 2 * outer_radius, outer_radius) \
     .threePointArc((width - outer_radius, 0), (width, outer_radius)) \
     .lineTo(width, height - outer_radius) \
     .threePointArc((width - outer_radius, height), (width - 2 * outer_radius, height - outer_radius)) \
     .lineTo(2 * outer_radius, height - outer_radius) \
     .threePointArc((outer_radius, height), (0, height - outer_radius)) \
     .lineTo(0, outer_radius) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = r.extrude(thickness)

# Define the sketch for the cutouts
cutout_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0174, 0.0199) \
            .lineTo(0.0174, 0.2974) \
            .threePointArc((0.0199, 0.2999), (0.0224, 0.2974)) \
            .lineTo(0.7276, 0.2974) \
            .threePointArc((0.7301, 0.2999), (0.7326, 0.2974)) \
            .lineTo(0.7326, 0.0199) \
            .threePointArc((0.7301, 0.0174), (0.7276, 0.0199)) \
            .lineTo(0.0224, 0.0199) \
            .threePointArc((0.0199, 0.0174), (0.0174, 0.0199)) \
            .close()

cutout_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0174, 0.0199) \
            .lineTo(0.0174, 0.2974) \
            .threePointArc((0.0199, 0.2999), (0.0224, 0.2974)) \
            .lineTo(0.7276, 0.2974) \
            .threePointArc((0.7301, 0.2999), (0.7326, 0.2974)) \
            .lineTo(0.7326, 0.0199) \
            .threePointArc((0.7301, 0.0174), (0.7276, 0.0199)) \
            .lineTo(0.0224, 0.0199) \
            .threePointArc((0.0199, 0.0174), (0.0174, 0.0199)) \
            .close()

# Perform the cutouts
r = r.cut(cutout_1.extrude(thickness))
r = r.cut(cutout_2.extrude(thickness))

# The final model is represented as 'r'
